data.title: Gas price increase notice from Erdgas Beispieltal GmbH
data.summary: Erdgas Beispieltal GmbH informs Johanna Beispielacker that gas prices will rise from 1 January 2027: the unit price (Arbeitspreis) increases from 9.84 ct/kWh to 11.12 ct/kWh and the monthly instalment (Abschlag) from €104.00 to €118.00. A special right to cancel without notice before the new prices take effect is granted.
data.explanation: Your gas supplier is raising its prices starting 1 January 2027, which also increases your monthly advance payment. Because of this price increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract without the usual notice period; the app will show the window you have to decide and send a cancellation if you choose to. If you do nothing, the new, higher prices and instalment will simply apply from the effective date. If you're unsure whether to switch providers, comparing offers before deciding may help, but this is a commercial decision, not a legal one requiring professional advice.
